# Psalm 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Of-the-servant of-YHWH, of-David, who spoke to-YHWH the-words of-this song on-the-day YHWH delivered-him from-the-hand of-all his-enemies and-from-the-hand of-Saul.

**2** And-he-said: I-love-You, YHWH, my-strength.

**3** YHWH [is] my-rock and-my-fortress and-my-deliverer; my-God, my-rock in-whom I-take-refuge; my-shield and-the-horn of-my-salvation, my-stronghold.

**4** [The One] praised I-call-upon — YHWH — and-from my-enemies I-am-saved.

**5** The-cords of-death encompassed-me, and-the-torrents of-destruction terrified-me.

**6** The-cords of-Sheol surrounded-me; the-snares of-death confronted-me.

**7** In-my-distress I-called-upon YHWH, and-to my-God I-cried-for-help. He-heard from-His-temple my-voice, and-my-cry before-Him came into-His-ears.

**8** Then-the-earth shook and-trembled; the-foundations of-the-mountains quaked and-were-shaken, because He-was-angry.

**9** Smoke went-up from-His-nostrils, and-fire from-His-mouth devoured; coals blazed from-Him.

**10** And-He-bowed the-heavens and-came-down, and-thick-darkness [was] under His-feet.

**11** And-He-rode upon a-cherub and-flew, and-He-soared upon the-wings of-the-wind.

**12** He-made darkness His-covering, His-canopy around-Him — darkness of-waters, thick-clouds of-the-skies.

**13** From-the-brightness before-Him His-clouds passed — hail and-coals of-fire.

**14** And-YHWH thundered in-the-heavens, and-the-Most-High gave His-voice — hail and-coals of-fire.

**15** And-He-sent His-arrows and-scattered-them, and-lightning-bolts many and-confused-them.

**16** And-the-channels of-waters were-seen, and-the-foundations of-the-world were-exposed, at-Your-rebuke, YHWH, at-the-blast of-the-breath of-Your-nostrils.

**17** He-sent from-on-high, He-took-me; He-drew-me from-many waters.

**18** He-delivered-me from-my-strong enemy, and-from-those-hating-me, for they-were-too-mighty for-me.

**19** They-confronted-me in-the-day of-my-calamity, but-YHWH was my-support.

**20** And-He-brought-me-out to-a-broad-place; He-delivered-me because He-delighted in-me.

**21** YHWH rewarded-me according-to my-righteousness; according-to the-cleanness of-my-hands He-repaid-me.

**22** For I-have-kept the-ways of-YHWH and-have-not wickedly-departed from-my-God.

**23** For all His-judgments [were] before-me, and-His-statutes I-did-not put-away from-me.

**24** And-I-was blameless with-Him, and-I-kept-myself from-my-iniquity.

**25** And-YHWH repaid-me according-to my-righteousness, according-to the-cleanness of-my-hands in-His-sight.

**26** With-the-faithful You-show-Yourself-faithful; with-the-blameless man You-show-Yourself-blameless.

**27** With-the-purified You-show-Yourself-pure, and-with-the-crooked You-show-Yourself-twisted.

**28** For You save a-humble people, but-haughty eyes You-bring-down.

**29** For You light my-lamp; YHWH my-God illumines my-darkness.

**30** For by-You I-run [against] a-troop, and-by-my-God I-leap a-wall.

**31** The-God — blameless [is] His-way; the-word of-YHWH is-refined; a-shield [is] He to-all who-take-refuge in-Him.

**32** For who [is] God except YHWH? And-who [is] a-rock except our-God?

**33** The-God who-girds-me [with] strength and-makes my-way blameless,

**34** making my-feet like-the-deer's, and-upon my-heights He-sets-me.

**35** He-trains my-hands for-war, so-that my-arms bend a-bow of-bronze.

**36** And-You-give-me the-shield of-Your-salvation, and-Your-right-hand supports-me, and-Your-gentleness makes-me-great.

**37** You-make-wide my-steps under-me, and-my-ankles do-not wobble.

**38** I-pursue my-enemies and-overtake-them, and-I-do-not return until-they-are-consumed.

**39** I-crush-them and-they-cannot rise; they-fall under my-feet.

**40** And-You-gird-me [with] strength for-battle; You-bring-down my-adversaries under-me.

**41** And-my-enemies — You-give-me [their] neck, and-those-hating-me — I-destroy-them.

**42** They-cry-out but-there-is-no-savior — to YHWH, but-He-does-not answer-them.

**43** And-I-beat-them fine as-dust before the-wind; like-mud of-the-streets I-pour-them-out.

**44** You-deliver-me from-the-strivings of-the-people; You-set-me as-head of-the-nations; a-people I-did-not-know serve-me.

**45** At-the-hearing of-the-ear they-obey-me; sons-of foreigners cringe before-me.

**46** Sons-of foreigners lose-heart and-come-trembling from-their-strongholds.

**47** YHWH lives! And-blessed [is] my-Rock! And-exalted [is] the-God of-my-salvation,

**48** the-God who-gives vengeance to-me and-subdues peoples under-me,

**49** who-delivers-me from-my-enemies. Indeed above-those-rising-against-me You-exalt-me; from-the-man of-violence You-deliver-me.

**50** Therefore I-praise-You among-the-nations, YHWH, and-to-Your-name I-sing-praise.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **18:1**: The superscription is the longest in the Psalter. This psalm also appears in 2 Samuel 22 with minor variations.

- **18:9-16**: A theophany — God appearing in cosmic storm imagery. The language echoes Sinai and Canaanite storm-god mythology, claimed for YHWH.

- **18:36**: 'Your gentleness (anvatkha) makes me great' — a stunning theological claim. Divine power works through gentleness.

— EMET
